text: Stuart McGhie, A/R Manager, Traffic Management, Work Zone Coordination and Traffic Mitigation will provide a presentation on Ensuring Safe and Accessible Routes in Construction Work Zones. Toronto is experiencing an unprecedented level of construction, with over 250 tower cranes in operation, multiple surface-level and below ground transit construction, and a large state of good repair program to upgrade aging road, water and utility infrastructure. The initiative to ensure safety and accessibility in construction zones is a broad effort involving all the City’s divisions responsible for capital works, as well as contractors, constructors, utilities, developers, and other public agencies.
The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee received the item for information.
